instruction: Remove Thunderbird from the dock favorites.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully removed vim from dock favorites by right-clicking the Vim icon and selecting 'Remove from Favorites'. Completed in 3 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can interact with GNOME dock, right-click context menus, select 'Remove from Favorites' option
metadata.task_rationale: Same removal pattern targeting a different app (Thunderbird) which sits at the top of the dock, testing positional generalization
metadata.explanation: Task requires removing Thunderbird from dock favorites. Evaluator checks that favorites list contains only vim and chrome after removal. Reuses official check_gnome_favorite_apps metric.
